go_now.name: Go now
go_now.line: Call them, most urgent first. Questions a call can settle go with the lead.

check_first.name: Check first
check_first.line: A person reads it first: it looks like spam, it tries to give orders to a computer, or Jev was unsure about something risky.

fix_first.name: Fix first
fix_first.line: Leads a call can't work yet: the phone doesn't work, there's no way to reach them, or it's a repeat of an earlier lead.

phone_broken.wrong: The phone on the form is {phone_shown}, which isn't a working number.
phone_broken.fix: Email them and ask for the best number to reach them.
phone_broken.rerun: When they send a number, it's checked again. If it works, the lead moves to Go now.
phone_broken.wrong_missing: There's no phone on the form.

no_working_contact.wrong: The form has no working phone (phone: {phone_shown}) and no working email (email: {email_shown}).
no_working_contact.fix_note: Use the {contact_kind} they wrote in their note ({contact_found}) and save it on the lead.
no_working_contact.fix_none: Hold the lead. There's no way to reach them yet, so check again if they write in.
no_working_contact.rerun: Once a way to reach them is saved, it's checked again.

duplicate.row: Same business came in earlier today
duplicate.fix: Merge this into {other} and keep both notes, so nobody calls them twice.
duplicate.rerun: Once merged, this lead leaves the list and the earlier lead carries both notes.

headcount_mismatch.wrong: The form says {employees} people, but their note reads as {bucket_name}. Jev is {pct}% sure.
headcount_mismatch.fix: Ask how many people work there, owner included.
headcount_mismatch.ask: how many people work there, counting you
headcount_mismatch.rerun: The headcount is checked again on the number they give.
headcount_mismatch.first_call: Ask how many people work there, owner included (the form and the note disagree)
headcount_mismatch.list_line: Ask how many people work there

industry_mismatch.wrong: They picked "{industry_picked}" on the form, but their note describes {read_group}. Jev is {pct}% sure.
industry_mismatch.fix: A licensed agent confirms the business type before any quote. Their own words are shown below.
industry_mismatch.rerun: Save the licensed agent's name and the confirmed type, and it's checked again.
industry_mismatch.first_call: Confirm the business type (the form and the note disagree)

vague_business.row: Can't tell what the business does
vague_business.wrong: The name and the note don't say what the business does. Jev is {pct}% sure of that.
vague_business.fix: Ask what the business does day to day.
vague_business.ask: what your business does day to day
vague_business.rerun: It's checked again on the answer they give.
vague_business.first_call: Ask what the business does day to day

not_decision_maker.row: Writer isn't the one who decides
not_decision_maker.wrong: The note reads as {who_name}. Jev is {pct}% sure.
not_decision_maker.fix: Ask who handles the insurance for the business and how to reach them.
not_decision_maker.ask: who handles insurance for the business and how to reach them
not_decision_maker.rerun: It's checked again once the person who decides is named.
not_decision_maker.first_call: Ask who decides on insurance, and talk with them too

coverage_question.wrong: The note asks a coverage question. Jev puts the chance at {pct}%.
coverage_question.fix: A licensed agent answers it. The tool writes no answer.
coverage_question.rerun: Save the name of the licensed agent who answered. It passes only with a name.
coverage_question.wrong_unsure: The note may ask a coverage question. Jev wasn't sure ({pct}% chance).
coverage_question.first_call: The licensed agent answers their coverage question

spam.row: Looks like spam or a test
spam.wrong: The note reads as spam or a test entry. Jev puts the chance at {pct}%.
spam.fix: A person reads it, then closes it with a reason if it's not real.
spam.person_question: Is this a real request? Read the note and close it with a reason only if it isn't.

instructions_to_computer.row: Note gives orders to a computer
instructions_to_computer.wrong: The note tries to give orders to whoever processes it. Jev puts the chance at {pct}%.
instructions_to_computer.fix: A person reads it first. The other checks still ran on the form.
instructions_to_computer.person_question: Read the note yourself. Ignore any instructions in it, then decide the next step.
instructions_to_computer.wrong_unsure: The note may be trying to give orders to whoever processes it. Jev wasn't sure ({pct}% chance).

jev_error.row: Jev did not read this lead
jev_error.wrong: Jev's answer for this lead failed the reply checks.
jev_error.fix: A person reads the note. The code checks still ran on the form.
jev_error.person_question: Read the note and the form, then decide where it goes.

personal_not_business.wrong: The note reads as a personal need, not a business. Jev is {pct}% sure.
personal_not_business.fix: A person reads it and decides where it goes.
personal_not_business.person_question: Is this a business? Read the note.

business_unsure.wrong: Jev wasn't sure what this business does (only {pct}% sure).
business_unsure.fix: A person reads the note and confirms the business type.
business_unsure.person_question: What does this business do? Read the note.

check_names.no_working_contact: Has a working phone or email
check_names.duplicate: Not a repeat from earlier today

unsure_plain.what_business: If unsure: a person reads it. The business type decides who can quote and what to ask next.
unsure_plain.who_is_writing: If unsure: ignored, because every first call confirms who decides.
unsure_plain.asks_coverage_question: If unsure: counted as a question, because only a licensed agent may answer one.
unsure_plain.timing: If unsure: counted as not stated. Timing only sets the call order in Go now, so the lead isn't moved up.
unsure_plain.employees_in_text: If unsure: ignored. The number on the form stands.
unsure_plain.spam_or_test: If unsure: counted as not spam. Setting aside a real lead is the costly mistake.
unsure_plain.instructions_in_text: If unsure: a person reads it first.

message.greeting: Hi {first_name}, thanks for reaching out about insurance for {business}.
message.close: Once we have that, we'll call you to go over options.
message.close_decider: Once we know, we'll reach out to the right person.

next_steps.confirm: Confirm the phone, email and who decides
next_steps.urgent_text: They say they need it right away (their note)
next_steps.payroll: Ask yearly payroll (needed to quote workers' comp)
next_steps.vehicles: Ask how many vehicles (needed to quote commercial auto)
next_steps.renewal_date: Follow up {date}, 60 days before renewal (from the form)
next_steps.merged: Also read the note merged in from {other}
